text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I shall get straight to the 
point.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I wish to challenge the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I wish to contest the stage where 
my peers 
have gathered—the stage that will decide 
the strongest of our generation.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Japan Cup is an international GⅠ race 
where foreign horsegirls are invited to 
compete in Japan.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
When it was first founded, strong foreign 
horsegirls dominated, 
but in recent years, victories by Japanese 
horsegirls have not been rare. 
Especially this year—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
El Condor Pasa, Special Week, 
Air Groove... A stellar lineup of 
heavyweights has assembled.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
That is precisely why she wishes to 
challenge the race 
that will decide the strongest of the 
generation. 
Her competitive spirit has caught fire.
choice_data_list:
The conditioning schedule will be brutal. 
Are you sure?

The conditioning schedule will be brutal. 
Are you sure?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: I ask for nothing less.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...! ...You have my gratitude.
choice_data_list: Leave it to me. I'll make it work.
Leave it to me. I'll make it work.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, respecting her wishes... 
I adjusted her schedule to ensure she'd be 
ready in time for the Japan Cup—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I am off to take on this 
challenge.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Trainer. For allowing me 
to advance to the Japan Cup.
choice_data_list:
Fulfilling your wishes is what a Trainer 
is for.

Fulfilling your wishes is what a Trainer 
is for.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... You have grown quite bold with your 
words.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
You have answered my wish. 
In kind, I must answer you with results.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And now, let us introduce the horsegirls 
competing in the Japan Cup! First up is 
El Condor Pasa!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Her brilliant run in the NHK Mile Cup! 
And her fierce showdown against Silence 
Suzuka in the Mainichi Okan 
must still be fresh in everyone's minds!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Looking to build momentum for her overseas 
expedition with a victory here... 
we eagerly await what kind of run she will 
deliver today!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
¡Bueno!! 
Today, I'll prove it!! That right here in 
Japan, 
we have horse girls who can beat the 
world's best!!

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
—I am the world's strongest "Monstrous 
Bird." 
And I won't give up my championship belt!!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Next is Air Groove! Last year, she ran 
a magnificent race in the Japan Cup, 
only to suffer a heartbreaking defeat to 
an international runner.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
To avenge that loss, the "Empress" has 
returned 
to the turf! Having conquered the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn), 
this formidable star takes on the world 
today!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I will clear my name. I will repay my 
debt. 
Only then will I truly be worthy of my 
title.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
I'll show them why they call me the 
"Empress."

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
And finally, Special Week! 
The Derby horse girl charging at the 
forefront of the racing world!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She tasted bitter defeat against Seiun Sky 
in the Kikuka Sho. 
Yet many still believe the strength that 
won her 
the Japanese Derby is the genuine article.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Still evolving, the leading star of her 
generation... 
Can she hold off the international 
contenders and claim the crown? 
All eyes are on this monumental race!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
I'm going to become the best horse girl in 
Japan! And for that— 
I want to beat the horse girls from all 
around the world, too!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Besides, Air Groove-san and El-chan are 
here... 
Everyone is so strong! Not a single one of 
them 
is going to let me pass easily.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Even so, that's why! 
To take a step closer to my dream, let me 
say it!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Today, I'm taking first place!
(Waaaaaaah!)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...What an incredible roar from the 
crowd. 
Yet above all—)

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
...Phew. —I won't lose. 
Watch over me, Moms.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
If I want to compete overseas, then here— 
I must conquer the world right here and 
now, yes!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...On such a grand stage, why are they so 
unshaken? 
In fact, why do they exude the commanding 
aura 
of true protagonists?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Yet I, too, have honed myself for this 
day. 
I have every right to grasp victory.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Phalaeno-san! 
Let's have a great race today!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, likewise. 
I have no intention of ending up as a mere 
decorative blossom.

text_block_list.name: El Condor Pasa
text_block_list.text:
Of course! —A fierce fight! A clash of 
titans! Absolute chaos! 
Bring it on from wherever you like, 
yeeees!!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Now, let us test our mettle.
